description:
https://buildwhatmovesindia.com/

We’ve finally kicked off Build What Moves India, and in this video, we go through exactly how the hackathon will work, what you need to build, and how your project will be judged. The focus is simple: take a public service platform, rethink it from the point of view of an everyday citizen, and build a working proof of concept with ideas that actually make the experience better.

We also cover the submission process, how the projects will be shortlisted, what the top 250 participants can expect, and how the mentorship round and final presentations will work.

Finally, we talk about what this hackathon is really trying to do. Beyond the prizes, the larger goal is to bring together people from technology, content, and government, and hopefully turn some of these ideas into conversations that can lead to real improvements in the public services millions of Indians use.
fulltitle: Build What Moves India: Rules & How to Participate

comments.text:
If you applied through the form, you are officially in! Even if you haven't received a confirmation email, your spot is secured. Please check your spam folder just in case.

The project submission link will be sent out on the 28th. It will be emailed to you directly and also posted publicly. Keep an eye out for it and remember to check your spam folder if you don't see it.

The maximum team size is strictly limited to 2 members. This is because we need to be able to fairly allocate prizes, mentor time, MacBooks, and the trip to SF.

If you already have a group of more than two people, you will need to split up into multiple teams. Everyone can still participate, so the extra members can simply form another team and submit their own project. No one has to sit out.
